organization.name: GravityCart
organization.description: GravityCart is a CE-certified, automotive-engineered gravity cart — dimensioned tolerances, proven brake components and mono-material recyclability, convertible between wheels and skis in under five minutes.

faq.a: Yes. The JM-001 chassis is CE certified and ISO 9001 verified, meeting the same safety and quality standards applied to automotive-grade vehicles sold in Europe.

faq.q: How long does it take to switch between wheels and skis?
faq.a: Under five minutes. The wheel assembly and ski assembly bolt to the identical chassis mount point, so one JM-001 frame covers both summer and winter riding without buying a second frame.

faq.q: What is the fork made from?
faq.a: A forged fork, built to automotive-tolerance geometry and shared across both the wheel and ski configurations, so steering feel stays identical between seasons.
Dual-piston Shimano hydraulic disc brakes — the same braking hardware proven on downhill mountain bikes for a decade, not a prototype component developed for marketing.

faq.q: What does a complete GravityCart setup cost?
faq.a: The JM-001 All-Season Chassis is €3,499 and ships with the wheel assembly mounted. Add the Ski Assembly Winter Kit for €799, or buy the Wheel Assembly Summer Kit on its own for €899. A Precision Maintenance Kit for seasonal conversion and upkeep is €129.
